info.description:
Provide the concepts of macroeconomics including: methods of measuring total output and general price level of the economy; Aggregate supply, aggregate demand and the method of determining the equilibrium of the economy; Inflation and unemployment; Introduction of macroeconomic policies used to regulate the economy; The macroeconomic issues of an open economy include the exchange rate, the balance of payments and the general equilibrium of the economy.

Chapter 1: Introduction to Macroeconomics

Chapter 2: Measuring National Income

Chapter 3: Production and Growth

Chapter 4: Unemployment

Chapter 5: Monetary System

Chapter 6: The Open Economy: The basic concepts

Chapter 7: Aggregate Demand and Aggregate Supply

Chapter 8: The Influence of Fiscal and Monetary Policy on Aggregate Demand
info.decisionNo: Ban hành theo QĐ CTĐT TDTU

clos.loDetails: Understand basic knowledge and tools for analyzing the economy in a holistic perspective and analyzing macroeconomic issues.
Master  theories of economics, principles of operation of macroeconomic policies.
Acquire independent thinking, logic, the ability to analyze, argue and demonstrate in solving economic problems.
